intelligence.title_original: Alarmed by the alarm: people react to ‘severe alert’ on phones over UK wildfires
intelligence.title_zh: 全球碳治理议题受到关注
intelligence.summary_source: Many complained online that piercingly loud tone was ‘overreach’ while others lamented lack of action on decarbonisation On Friday at 7pm, Thérèse Coffey was nine miles away from a nuclear power station when her phone made a loud, piercing and very worrying sound: it was a “severe” emergency alert . “Was expecting [a] much more specific alert, not a generic message on wildfires,” the former Conservative cabinet minister said on X. She wasn’t alone in being alarmed by the alarm sent to phones in England and Wales. In the aftermath, thousands of social media users expressed their shock at alert. Some shared funny memes and others lamented what they viewed as lack of government action on decarbonisation. Academic John Ritzema called it a “massive overreach” and said the alert system should be “be for ‘drop everything and prepare for something terrible’ situations”, something Coffey echoed, saying alerts should not become commonplace to avoid “Peter cries wolf situations”. Continue reading...

key_decisions.title: Global Mutirão: Uniting humanity in a global mobilization against climate change
key_decisions.why_zh: 贝伦会议总括性决定，连接全球盘点实施、NDC 与气候资金后续工作。

key_decisions.title: Matters related to the global stocktake
key_decisions.why_zh: 跟踪首次全球盘点成果如何进入后续实施与第二次盘点。

key_decisions.title: New collective quantified goal on climate finance
key_decisions.why_zh: 巴库新集体量化气候资金目标，是资金谈判的关键基准。

key_decisions.title: Outcome of the first global stocktake
key_decisions.why_zh: 首次全球盘点成果，是新一轮 NDC 编制与能源转型表述的核心依据。

key_decisions.title: Sharm el-Sheikh Implementation Plan
key_decisions.why_zh: 沙姆沙伊赫实施计划，强调从承诺转向实施。

key_decisions.title: Glasgow Climate Pact
key_decisions.why_zh: 格拉斯哥气候协议，涉及减缓雄心、资金、适应与损失损害。

key_decisions.title: Chile Madrid Time for Action
key_decisions.why_zh: 马德里会议总括性政治决定。

key_decisions.title: Preparations for the implementation of the Paris Agreement and the first session of the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to the Paris Agreement
key_decisions.why_zh: 卡托维兹气候一揽子规则的总括性决定。

key_decisions.title: Fiji momentum for implementation
key_decisions.why_zh: 推动 2018 年促进性对话和巴黎规则工作计划。

key_decisions.title: Preparations for the entry into force of the Paris Agreement and the first session of the Conference of the Parties serving as the meeting of the Parties to the Paris Agreement
key_decisions.why_zh: 衔接《巴黎协定》生效与实施规则谈判。

key_decisions.title: Adoption of the Paris Agreement
key_decisions.why_zh: 《巴黎协定》的通过决定，是后续 NDC、透明度和全球盘点制度的法律起点。
